mapper.select: select a.*, b.TYPE as bizPrjType, b.NAME as bizPrjName, b.SN as bizPrjSn, b.LOCATION as bizPrjLocation, b.SOURCE as bizPrjSource from BIZ_POR_PROJECT a left join BIZ_PROJECT b on a.PROJECT_ID = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.*, b.TYPE as bizPrjType, b.NAME as bizPrjName, b.SN as bizPrjSn, b.LOCATION as bizPrjLocation, b.SOURCE as bizPrjSource from BIZ_POR_PROJECT a left join BIZ_PROJECT b on a.PROJECT_ID = b.ID where a.ID = #{id}

select a.*, b.SN as bizProjectSn,b.NAME as bizProjectName, b.IS_EPC as isEpc,b.IS_EPCF as isEpcf,b.IS_LEAD as isLead, b.TYPE as bizProjectType,b.INDUSTRY_CLASSIFICATION as industryClassification, b.IS_CONSORTIUM as isConsortium,b.REGION as region,b.LOCATION as bizProjectLocation,b.MANAGE_DEPT as manageDept from BIZ_CRM_HETONG a join BIZ_PROJECT b on a.BIZ_PROJECT_ID = b.ID where a.BIZ_PROJECT_ID = #{bizProjectId} and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.STATUS in ('0','1')

select b.* from BIZ_CRM_HETONG a join FIN_DATA_PPC b on a.ID = b.CONTRACT_ID where a.BIZ_PROJECT_ID = #{bizProjectId} and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.STATUS in ('0','1') and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'

select b.* from BIZ_CRM_HETONG a join BIZ_CRM_SUBCONTRACT b on a.ID = b.HETONG_ID where a.BIZ_PROJECT_ID = #{bizProjectId} and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.STATUS in ('0','1') and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and b.STATUS in ('0','1')

select a.*, b.SN as sn,b.MODEL_ID as modelId,b.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID as processInstanceId,b.STATUS as status, b.APPLY_UNIT as applyUnit,b.BILL_UNIT as billUnit,b.HT_PROJECT_NAME as htProjectName,b.FP_TYPE as fpType, b.HT_CONTRACT_NO as htContractNo,b.HT_CONTRACT_AMOUNT as htContractAmount,b.HT_COUNTERPARTY as htCounterparty, b.PURCHASER as purchaser,b.HT_COMPANY_OR_DEPARTMENT as htCompanyOrDepartment,b.HT_OWNER as htOwner,b.APPLY_NAME as applyName, b.GATHER_TYPE as gatherType,b.TAX_DIFF_RATE as taxDiffRate,b.YS_TAX_DIFF as ysTaxDiff,b.OTHER_MEMO as otherMemo from BIZ_INVOICE_SALE_BILL a join BIZ_INVOICE_SALE b on a.INVOICE_SALE_ID = b.ID join BIZ_CRM_HETONG c on b.HT_ID = c.ID where c.BIZ_PROJECT_ID = #{bizProjectId} and c.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and c.STATUS in ('0','1') and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and b.STATUS in ('1') and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'
